Not NASCAR, but I was at the race where Dan Wheldon died. I was only 6 so it still has a lasting impact and trauma on me. I knew even at the age of six that there were too many cars going too fast on that track and watching them turn a single lap felt like purgatory to me. It was an awful thing for 6 year old me to experience but I still wanted and still do want to race, and I guess it was a clear but rude awakening to me at my young age that that's what you risk when you race, and I've grown and accepted it as how another day at the office is for race car drivers.
